sampling: independent harmonic-ring Gaussian proposals, exact rejection exp(-beta*alpha*mean(q^4)); independent canonical momenta
correlation_estimator: all saved time origins within each independent trajectory; known symmetry mean(q)=0; equal trajectory and batch weights
spectrum: Splus=(2/pi)*integral_0^T C(t)*exp(-eta*t)*cos(omega*t)dt; absolute, no area normalization or clipping

gates.step_and_bead_statistical_rule: report discrepancy and independent batch uncertainty; a comparison below sampling resolution is a bound, not an exact zero discretization error

output_policy: retain per-batch correlation/spectrum, initial/final diagnostics, source/config/seed hashes; do not retain full trajectories
